content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London's O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and lorry, prompting the London fire brigade to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday; after about an hour and 25 firefighters, the blaze was contained with no injuries reported, and the service later posted on X that the fire followed a pre‑planned filming event near the venue, which will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas the following week, noting that a van was destroyed, most of a car and lorry were harmed, and there were no injuries, adding that the fire originated from a controlled explosion that got out of hand, crews stayed on scene, and the site is close to the Thames cable car link, while a Met police spokesman said they were aware of explosion reports heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
